LESSON: KENYAN FOLK DANCE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.3: Kenyan Folk Dance

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Kenyan Folk Dance. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it necessary to perform a folk dance?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance
2. describe components of a Kenyan folk dance
3. discuss the roles of folk dance in the community
4. perform in a folk dance from a Kenyan indigenous community

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KENYAN FOLK DANCE
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Kenyan Folk Dance helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: KENYAN FOLK DANCE
Study Kenyan Folk Dance like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Kenyan Folk Dance” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe components of a Kenyan folk dance

What this means
In this part you learn to describe components of a Kenyan folk dance. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe components of a Kenyan folk dance.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Kenyan Folk Dance in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe components of a Kenyan folk dance. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Discuss the roles of folk dance in the community

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss the roles of folk dance in the community. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss the roles of folk dance in the community.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss the roles of folk dance in the community. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Perform in a folk dance from a Kenyan indigenous community

What this means
In this part you learn to perform in a folk dance from a Kenyan indigenous community. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform in a folk dance from a Kenyan indigenous community.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Kenyan Folk Dance” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform in a folk dance from a Kenyan indigenous community. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Kenyan Folk Dance is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Kenyan Folk Dance” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Kenyan Folk Dance in your own words. (skill: describe components of a Kenyan folk dance)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: discuss the roles of folk dance in the community)

Example 4: Show how “Kenyan Folk Dance” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: perform in a folk dance from a Kenyan indigenous community)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kenyan Folk Dance to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance.
3. Practise this skill: describe components of a Kenyan folk dance.
4. Practise this skill: discuss the roles of folk dance in the community.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kenyan Folk Dance from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kenyan Folk Dance: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Kenyan Folk Dance?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it necessary to perform a folk dance?
2. How do the components of a folk dance contribute to its performance?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Kenyan Folk Dance means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: discuss the background of a Kenyan folk dance.
5. Be able to: describe components of a Kenyan folk dance.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
